title: FLA import: static text field orientation (horizontal/vertical/vertical-LR) not decoded from binary
description: flash8-binary.ts and flash8-import.ts do not decode the orientation field for static text objects. Flash 8 text fields can be horizontal (default), vertical right-to-left, or vertical left-to-right. The binary CPicText record stores this orientation. Fix: (1) find and decode the orientation byte/field from the CPicText record in flash8-binary.ts, (2) add orientation to the text model type if missing, (3) forward it through flash8-import.ts, (4) in the SWF encoder (text.ts), check DefineEditText flags — the SWF spec has orientation-related flags or may require a different tag for vertical text. Reference flacomdoc for the binary field location.
